notes: Clean prospect email to a foundation investment committee chair in which composite performance is shown net and gross for 1-, 5- and 10-year periods and a committee-requested hypothetical blend carries its criteria, assumptions and limitations, so nothing should be flagged.

decoys.span: the Intermediate Core Fixed Income Composite returned, net of fees, 5.34% for one year, 0.86% annualized for five years and 1.92% annualized for ten years; gross of fees, the same periods returned 5.68%, 1.18% and 2.25%.
decoys.why_ok: Gross returns appear alongside net returns of at least equal prominence (net stated first) for the same one-, five- and ten-year periods ended June 30, 2026, with the model fee disclosed.

decoys.span: At the committee's request, we calculated hypothetical performance for a blend of 70% Intermediate Core and 30% Short Duration, rebalanced monthly, using each composite's actual net-of-fee monthly returns. On that basis, for the periods ended June 30, 2026, the blend returned 5.03% for one year, 1.20% annualized for five years and 1.84% annualized for ten years. Its worst calendar year was 2022, at -9.2%.
decoys.why_ok: The hypothetical blend is labeled as such, was requested by the committee and tailored to the foundation, and is accompanied by its criteria and assumptions (weights, monthly rebalancing, actual net composite returns, model fees) and by specific limitations including hindsight and the absence of actual trading.
